integration_contract.meshes: explicit constant triangles and immutable bind UV for every surface/panel; renderer may not infer diagonals
integration_contract.solid_material_coverage: outer v4 anatomical silhouette clips all coverage per surface; internal triangle seam coverage may never extend beyond it
integration_contract.sampling: own-material RGB input, optional authored silhouette alpha may subtract from outer mesh envelope; conservative seam footprint clipped before composition
integration_contract.invalid_faces: reject flipped faces; do not rasterize zero-area fold faces
integration_contract.art_status: attempt02 is immutable rejected evidence, technical RGB input only; attempt03 prohibited until two v4 reviews and CTO release

far_leg_skin.visibility: no alpha cutoff; fixed faces lose projected area continuously, zero faces remain in topology
far_leg_skin.texture: skin base and broad light only in full joint band+guard; no interior dark line, contour ring, embroidery or high-frequency detail; continuous exterior outline allowed on outer edge only
far_leg_skin.sampling: straight alpha source; clamp at texture border; duplicate skin color through 4px guard; no per-pose UV projection
